historical_reviews.deepseek: Fails to distinguish L1 link state from D3 device power state or their disruption.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Requires bounded vendor controls and preserves diagnostics.
historical_reviews.related_cases: Row317 is D3-only and must not erase this combined L1+D3 coverage.

original_test_intent: Cycle approved PCIe paths through both L1 link power management and D3 device power states for 10,000 loops, verifying entry, wake, re-enumeration and error-free service recovery each time.
original_method: Pin vendor module/config; map bridge/endpoint capabilities and safe allowlist; distinguish L1/L1 substates from D3hot/D3cold and wake mechanisms; preserve baseline link/power/driver/log/I/O; approve sequencing/timing/oracle; drain services; run with first-failure stop; restore policy and endpoint state.
manual_activity: PCIe/power owner approves states, wake paths and target scope; operator coordinates I/O drain and recovery.
required_inputs: Exact L1/D3 state sequence, dwell and 10,000-loop meaning
safety_requirements: Stop on failed wake/re-enumeration, AER, I/O or management anomaly
agent_execution_scope: Run one bounded combined L1/D3 campaign
Restore policy/services and report without DUT verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Generic NVQual execution omits state definitions, capability checks and 10,000 wake cycles.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use only the pinned vendor module on allowlisted capable paths with explicit L1 and D3 entry/exit verification.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Both L1 and D3 coverage and the 10,000-loop count are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Log requested/observed L1 and D3 substates, wake cause, enumeration, speed/width, driver and AER for each cycle.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Separates link and device states and adds capability-aware recovery.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: D3-only execution cannot prove the row's L1 behavior.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: D3cold may remove auxiliary power and require platform-specific wake; L1 substates depend on both ends and policy.

project_override_considerations: Platform owner decides exact L1 substates and D3hot/D3cold scope and whether cycles apply to combined sequences or each state.
expected_evidence: Restored policy/final health and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure requires 10,000 combined L1/D3 power-state cycles while Criteria only address readable text and firmware; clearing logs conflicts with evidence preservation.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Safe capable targets can be provisioned; unsupported or critical paths block only their execution.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Compatibility row316 Wistron-NV GPU-00309-V003: define exact L1/L1-substate and D3hot/D3cold sequence, capability/wake matrix, safe target allowlist, 10,000-loop semantics, per-state recovery/error oracle and policy restore; preserve logs and map/replace unrelated Criteria.

review_improvement: Separates link-level L1 from device-level D3 and makes every entry/wake cycle capability-aware and reversible.
independent_technical_reasoning: L1 leaves device configuration present while D3—especially D3cold—can remove power and require re-enumeration. Treating them as one unnamed power state would miss different failure modes and could strand endpoints without a valid wake mechanism.
